'''Trede Bakvalen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Bakarn family|Bakvalen family]], a Human family from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
